name: joy2know-tianyin-maestro
description: joy2know Tianyin Music Maestro: turns a rough idea into ready-to-paste input for NetEase Tianyin's AI song composer — a simple-mode inspiration paragraph, or an advanced-mode pair of a style description plus section-tagged lyrics — matched to one of 18 style tags and one of 18 virtual-singer timbres, with the panel picks (vocal gender, chorus-first toggle, song title) and the pure-music and reference-audio routes covered. Also writes lyrics from scratch (hook-first, genre-accurate rhyme schemes, a cliche blacklist) and designs whole albums (one Q&A round to an album plan document plus a per-song paste list, with timbre anchors, a difference matrix and per-song cover prompts). Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Turns ideas into ready-to-paste Tianyin input, writes lyrics that sing, and designs whole albums. Text only.
displayDescription.zh: 把想法写成能粘进网易天音的输入：灵感一段话或风格描述加歌词两栏，配 18 位虚拟歌手。也写歌词、设计专辑。仅产文本。
